svg.aria-label: Loki. Private AI assistant that runs entirely on your own PC. Local models through Ollama; nothing goes to the cloud. Auto-picks the right model for chat, code, reasoning or web; Web research with cited sources, page reading; Sees your screen and suggests PowerShell fixes you approve; Edits project files as reviewable diffs with undo; Builds and previews small websites in a sandbox. Built with Python, FastAPI, Ollama, JavaScript, PowerShell.

g.text: Private AI assistant that runs entirely on your own PC.
